title: Empty Long Pole Masonry Hod
description: One newly authored complete empty static masonry material hod. A deep open-top, open-front tapered timber trough has two continuous sloping sides, a narrow thick full floor and a full rear stop board. A long round solid carrying pole meets a complete under-head cradle through a fixed metal ferrule, placing the pole below the head rather than behind and in line with a shallow shovel blade. No wheel, rear legs, handle pair, slatted feed rack, lower catch basin, bricks or mortar are included. All geometry is new, not a resized wheelbarrow tub, rehandled snow scoop or cropped hay manger. Four editable closed meshes and three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres/nativeZup/full horizontal bounds-centred lowest pole-end origin. One whole prop and zero scenes. Upright inventory display only: the pole end on the preview plane does not establish unattended balance, carrying pose or a usable ground stand. No human, real carrying capacity, material retention, manufacture, ergonomics, load, stability, construction work or safety claim.
